item.title: US says China chip policies unfair but will delay tariffs to 2027
item.description: US trade officials determined that China should be punished for employing unfair tactics to dominate the semiconductor industry, but will wait 18 months to impose tariffs, American authorities said Tuesday. item.title: Engine idling law nets 660 fines amid 13,500 complaints since 2011 implementation
item.description: Hong Kong authorities have issued 660 fixed penalty notices since 2011 after engine idling was banned to reduce air pollution.
